description.value:
Requirements You have a hand free.

The bound blade flies back to your hand from as far as 40 feet at attunement 3, rising to 300 feet at 10. On the way it smashes through thin barriers: wood, plaster, glass, a plank door. A stone or metal wall stops it. If a creature is holding the blade, it strains toward you but doesn't tear free.

Uses per Communion: 1 at attunement 3, rising to 4 at 9 and unlimited at 10; 1 more while the Ansu trusts you.

The Salbarium in the blade's core answers the bearer's will. That is a property of the metal, not a spell.
